data.explanation: The change in the first letter of the Corporate Identity Number from 'U' (unlisted) to 'L' (listed) reflects the company's change in status after becoming a publicly traded entity.
data.reconciliation: The CIN prefix is updated by the Registrar of Companies when a company transitions from unlisted to listed status; both values are correct for the respective time periods.
